messages:
lia (sec): FYI — alert from our audit pipeline: svc-batch.service-account performed KMS:Decrypt on customer-pii CMK and then S3:GetObject on s3://redwood-customer-pii at 22:13 UTC. Not expected after the RBAC refactor earlier tonight. @andrew @sam :eyes:
andrew (infra): copy. which refactor PR are we blaming? link?
lia (sec): looks like the role-mapping change merged in 2356118000 — it replaced 'analytics-readers' -> 'data-readers' and the mapping script accidentally added svc-batch to data-readers. Here's the log snippet:
```
# auditd excerpt
principal=svc-batch@k8s cluster
action=KMS:Decrypt
key=cust-pii-cmk
resource=s3://redwood-customer-pii/2026/03/19/uid-xxxxx.json
src_ip=10.12.45.7
msg=policy-eval: ALLOWED via binding data-readers -> analytics-readers-mapping
```
maria (prod-eng): oh no — svc-batch processes anonymized data but should never access raw PII. immediate steps?
sam (sre-oncall): mitigation checklist: 1) remove binding 2) revoke SA tokens 3) rotate CMK access policy and produce audit snapshot 4) block S3 reads via bucket policy if needed. I'll take 1+2 now.
andrew (infra): running command to remove binding (dry-run first):
```
rbacctl remove-binding --role data-readers --member "svcacct:svc-batch@prod" --dry-runrbacctl remove-binding --role data-readers --member "svcacct:svc-batch@prod"
```
deploy-bot: action queued: rbacctl remove-binding job started by andrew (infra). Job ID: job-8932.
lia (sec): also create temporary explicit deny on bucket and KMS key so even if bindings slip, requests fail fast. Example bucket policy snippet to apply (add as ACL override):
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "TemporaryDenySvcBatch",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/svc-batch"},
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-customer-pii/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
andrew (infra): removed binding, uids: svc-batch -> data-readers removed. Confirmed via `rbacctl list-bindings --member svcacct:svc-batch@prod` returns empty.
audit-bot: ALERT: policy-change-detected by change-detector. Change: removed binding data-readers -> svc-batch. Timestamp 2356123602.
sam (sre-oncall): revoked svc-batch SA tokens, restarted deployment with new projected SA token TTL 5m. Command used: `kubectl delete secret svc-batch-sa-token -n prod` then rollout restart.
maria (prod-eng): quick note — svc-batch will have a short outage ~30s on restart, ok for pipeline.
lia (sec): next: KMS access — even though binding is removed, keys were used. We need a CMK rekey or at least rotate key policy and enable Key Access Auditing. I recommend rotating (create new key, reencrypt bucket metadata) and add deny for svc-batch on key policy. Who owns CMK? @andrew?
andrew (infra): I own key policies for now. Plan: 1) add deny for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/svc-batch` to CMK policy 2) create new key and schedule re-encrypt job for objects we've identified. Will post timeline in incidents board.
lia (sec): please snapshot current access logs and KMS decrypt logs before rotation. We need full list of objects accessed for incident scope. Use this query to CloudTrail/ELK:
```
index=cloudtrail action=KMS:Decrypt AND userIdentity.principalId=\"svc-batch\" | table eventTime,requestParameters.keyId,requestParameters.ciphertext
```
andrew (infra): snapshot created and uploaded to secure incident bucket at s3://redwood-incidents/2356123456/snapshot.json (read-only for sec+infra).
lia (sec): good. Also create a denylist in RBAC migration config so the mapping script can't re-add svc-batch in next deploy: add `excluded_members: [\"svcacct:svc-batch@prod\"]` to mappings.yaml and CI check.
maria (prod-eng): will add the exclusion and a unit test to the mapping repo. PR target asap.
sam (sre-oncall): tagging incident INC-2026-0330-01, creating PagerDuty runbook link. Oncall will monitor for any further s3 access from svc-batch for next 48h.
lia (sec): quick ask — anyone with write access to mapping repo, please avoid merging until we add the test. I'm locking merges for 30m. :lock:
andrew (infra): locking done. Also adding short-term policy: require approval from @lia for any role mapping PRs.
lia (sec): final: we're treating this as a P1 access regression. Postmortem owner: maria (prod-eng). Timeline: root cause is mapping script trusting labels -> mapping; fix: explicit allowlists + denylist + CI policy enforcement + KMS key-policy hardening. Will follow-up with next steps after evidence review.
maria (prod-eng): ack, will own postmortem and file an ops-runbook to prevent reoccurrence. ETA first draft in 48h.
lia (sec): thanks all. If you see any outgoing alerts from svc-batch -> s3 or KMS after 2356123960 ping here immediately. :thumbsup:
